OYEN

Dispatch 07 · Nov 2026

New instrument — FR-2

Record the room you’re in.

FR-2 is a pocket recorder with two capsules that turn, one dial, and nothing to set before you press record.

Pre-order FR-2

€349 · Ships 2 December

Fig. 1 — FR-2, front and side

What’s on it

1

Capsules that turn

X/Y for the scene in front of you, A/B for the room around you. A quarter turn sets them, and they stay put.

2

A hold switch

Slide it and the buttons sleep while the recording carries on: thirty hours on a charge, on a card of up to 1 TB.

3

One dial

Headphone level, menus and markers. It clicks once per step, so you can work it by feel in the dark.

4

Record, always

It records in 32-bit float, so there’s no gain to set and nothing to clip. A whisper and a door slam both come home whole.

Specifications

Recording32-bit float, up to 192 kHz
CapsulesTwo cardioids, X/Y or A/B
Input3.5 mm, line or plug-in power
Battery30 hours, USB-C charging
StoragemicroSD, up to 1 TB
Size132 × 68 × 24 mm, 186 g

From the field

“I left it on a fence post through nine hours of rain. It kept recording, and so did the birds.”

Maren Achterberg, sound recordist

First run · 2,000 instruments

€349

Ships 2 December. Charged when it ships.

Pre-order FR-2

OYEN

OYEN (https://oyen.example)

Dispatch 07 · Nov 2026

New instrument — FR-2

RECORD THE ROOM YOU’RE IN.

FR-2 is a pocket recorder with two capsules that turn, one dial, and nothing to set before you press record.

Pre-order FR-2 (https://oyen.example/fr-2)

€349 · Ships 2 December

[A technical drawing of FR-2 from the front and the side: two capsules at 90 degrees on top, a display, a large dial, and play, stop and record buttons. It is 132 by 68 by 24 millimetres.]

Fig. 1 — FR-2, front and side

What’s on it

1

Capsules that turn

X/Y for the scene in front of you, A/B for the room around you. A quarter turn sets them, and they stay put.

2

A hold switch

Slide it and the buttons sleep while the recording carries on: thirty hours on a charge, on a card of up to 1 TB.

3

One dial

Headphone level, menus and markers. It clicks once per step, so you can work it by feel in the dark.

4

Record, always

It records in 32-bit float, so there’s no gain to set and nothing to clip. A whisper and a door slam both come home whole.

Specifications

Recording | 32-bit float, up to 192 kHz
Capsules | Two cardioids, X/Y or A/B
Input | 3.5 mm, line or plug-in power
Battery | 30 hours, USB-C charging
Storage | microSD, up to 1 TB
Size | 132 × 68 × 24 mm, 186 g

From the field

“I left it on a fence post through nine hours of rain. It kept recording, and so did the birds.”

Maren Achterberg, sound recordist

First run · 2,000 instruments

€349

Ships 2 December. Charged when it ships.

Pre-order FR-2 (https://oyen.example/fr-2)
